messages:
Priya: Starting a cross-team run with MarinerTech — objective: quantify throughput-per-watt and 99/95 tail latency changes from their kernel IO scheduler patches + our runtime. Need matrix, telemetry schema, and go/no-go for a joint blog.
Tom (MarinerTech): Thanks — we can provide two kernel variants: mt-sched-v1 (IO-centric) and mt-sched-v2 (IO+affinity). Both add a small sysctl set. We can also stream per-board power via our agent.
Jin: Test matrix suggestion: (A) stock image, (B) mt-sched-v1, (C) mt-sched-v2, (D) mt-sched-v2 + thermal cap (limit watt). Run each 3x. Metrics: tokens/s, p99 latency, energy-per-token (J/token).
Luca: Hardware: 3 x mariner-e3 nodes (64GB, 8xGPU) and 1 edge micro (4GPU). I'll spin up and put results at s3://redwood-mariner/2065432100/results/
Priya: Good. Keep the public framing minimal: "Redwood x MarinerTech: kernel-level scheduling tweaks that improve inference energy efficiency" — only if results are consistent. Legal will want pre-approval.
OpsBot: Schedule created: kickoff=2065432100, dry-run=2065432800, full-run window=2065433000-2065434200. Alerts -> #bench-ops.
Jin: Workloads: long-gen (seq=2048, batch=2), burst-chat (seq=64, batch=64), and a synthetic microbench (single-token hotloop, threads=1/4/16). We'll collect CPU/GPU power, host temps, and kernel traces on regressions.
Tom (MarinerTech): We will export PMU counters + per-rail power. We can also flip a bandwidth limiter to emulate noisy neighbor.
Priya: Telemetry format: JSONL lines with fields [ts_iso, host, gpu_power_w, board_power_w, tokens_generated, latency_ms_p50_p95_p99, kernel_label]. Please include run_id.
Jin: Agreed. Also include a small CSV summary per run (run_id, median_j_per_token, tokens_per_sec, p99_ms). That will make quick comparisons easier.
Luca: Dry-run command (example):
```
./run_inference_bench --model rwd-4b --seq 2048 --batch 2 --profile energy --out s3://redwood-mariner/2065432100/results/dryrun1.json --run-id dry-1
```
Luca: Pushing bench harness to repo: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/bench/mariner-experiments (branch mariner-sched).
Tom (MarinerTech): We'll upload kernel tarballs + sysctl list to s3://redwood-mariner/2065432100/artifacts/ once ready (ETA 48h).
Priya: Ownership: Luca -> infra + runs; Jin -> metrics & analysis scripts; Tom -> kernel artifacts & telemetry hook; Priya -> partner comms & announcement draft + legal. Check-in 48h.
Jin: Acceptance criteria suggestion: >=12% reduction in J/token across both long-gen and burst-chat and no >1.5x p99 regression. If not met, capture diffs and iterate on knob set.
Tom (MarinerTech): Sounds reasonable. We'll also log /sys/kernel/debug/sched and iostat snapshots for each run.
Luca: If anyone wants live tails I'll stream runner logs to #bench-ops. Post-summary will include CSVs and a short QA document describing env and seed prompts.
Priya: One more thing: embargo window for data — partners agreed to 72h internal review before any public post. Flagging Legal. :lock:
OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up at 2065433700 (48h check).
Tom (MarinerTech): Noted. Will coordinate with firmware for power clamp if we use thermal cap scenario.
Priya: Thanks all — aiming to have dry-run data and a quick comparison table after the dry-run. If dry-run looks promising we'll draft a joint blog and a short notebook for reproducibility. :sparkles:
